messages:
Maria Gonzalez: circling back on the authz postmortem — quick triage thread for owners + deadlines. main issues: missing token validation in legacy proxy, gaps in audit logging for delegated perms, and secrets rotation not enforced on service accounts.
Samir Patel: I can own the token validation fix in the proxy. estimate 3 days for a patch + tests.
JD: can you also add a compatibility check to avoid breaking older clients?
Samir Patel: yes — plan: add validation middleware, flag to enable compat mode, unit tests, and rollout canary.
Elaine Cho: i'll take audit logging gaps. will instrument the delegated-perms path and backfill logs for the last 7 days where possible.
Maria Gonzalez: thanks. can each person add a short PR link when ready and post the rollout window in this thread.
Samir Patel: action item A1: proxy token validation. owner: Samir. due: 2026-04-02. PR will link here when ready.
Elaine Cho: action item A2: delegated-perms audit. owner: Elaine. due: 2026-04-05. plan includes a small migration to populate missing events.
JD: action item A3: compatibility tests + e2e. owner: JD. due: 2026-04-03. will add nightly job to catch regressions.
Maria Gonzalez: action item A4: secrets rotation policy enforcement for service accounts. owner: security-bot (working with infra). due: 2026-04-08.
security-bot: scheduled a rotation scan job: weekly, starting 2026-03-29. will post results to #security-reports.
ops-bot: deploy-canary job queued for proxy patch once PR is merged. reminder: tag canary with release-candidate and monitor latency/5xx for 30m.
Samir Patel: quick note — proxy change will include a short lived feature flag: 'authz.strict_token_validation'. enable in canary, evaluate metrics, then flip cluster-wide.
Elaine Cho: for audit backfill i posted the query i'll run in the infra-runbook channel. copying results here after run.
Maria Gonzalez: pattern note from postmortem: we see recurring small auth checks bypassed in older clients. long-term item: formalize an annual compatibility sweep. owner: JD. due: 2026-06-01.
JD: ack'd on annual sweep. adding to eng-runtime roadmap.
Samir Patel: posting the initial PR in 2 days. will tag reviewers: @ElaineCho @JD @MariaG.
Maria Gonzalez: great. once PRs are linked, i'll update the postmortem doc with owners+dates and mark this incident as 'in remediation'.
Elaine Cho: thanks — will also open a short runbook entry for audit gap response procedures.
Maria Gonzalez: anyone else? otherwise we'll reconvene in 2 weeks for a status check and close items as completed. :calendar: 
Samir Patel: no more from me. :thumbsup:
JD: all good here.
ops-bot: note: alert rule 'proxy-5xx-spike' muted for canary window per Maria Gonzalez at 1768458200.
Maria Gonzalez: closing comments — prioritize preventing recurrence over quick hacks. if owners need extra headcount, flag in this thread.
